Building and bases

Building piece won't line up? Hold Rotate

In Build mode, select a piece before adjusting its orientation. Tapping Rotate turns it 45 degrees; holding rotates smoothly for finer placement. Check the preview before placing to avoid rebuilding.

The center of the screen shows the resource cost: green means sufficient materials, red means insufficient. Check orientation, cost and placement preview together rather than merely checking for wood in your inventory.
